basic_details.job_title: Darbhanga Judgeship Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 3 Stenographer, Clerk, Peon / Orderly Posts
basic_details.short_information: The Office of the Principal District & Sessions Judge, Darbhanga is engaging three support staff for the Evening Court, Darbhanga on a contractual basis: one Stenographer, one Clerk and one Peon / Orderly. Only retired employees of the Civil Courts may apply. Applications must reach the Office of the Principal District & Sessions Judge, Darbhanga on or before 5 December 2026, either personally or through registered post.

content_sections.heading: About Darbhanga Civil Court
content_sections.text: The notice is issued by the Office of the Principal District & Sessions Judge, Darbhanga, which heads the Darbhanga Judgeship in Bihar. The posts are support staff for the Evening Court of the Darbhanga Judgeship. The notice has been forwarded to all Principal District & Sessions Judges of Bihar for display on their notice boards, and to the Judge-in-Charge, Civil Courts, Benipur / Biraul.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications must reach the Office of the Principal District & Sessions Judge, Darbhanga on or before 5 December 2026. The notice allows two ways of submission: Handing in the application personally at the office, or Sending it through registered post. The notice says the deadline is for receipt, so an application sent by post must reach the office by 5 December 2026. The notice does not attach a prescribed application form and does not list the documents to enclose.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The applicant must be a retired employee of the Civil Courts. Only retired court employees who have retired within the last three years, as per the guidelines issued by the Hon'ble High Court, Patna, are eligible. The applicant must be physically and mentally fit to discharge the duties assigned to the respective post. The applicant must possess satisfactory service records. The applicant should not have been subjected to any major disciplinary punishment during service. The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification or an age limit for any of the posts. Candidates should check the official notification for the requirements of each post. The notice prints no amount. It states that the period of engagement, remuneration and other conditions shall be governed by the applicable rules, guidelines and orders of the competent authority.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in Darbhanga Civil Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 posts in the Evening Court, Darbhanga: one Stenographer, one Clerk and one Peon / Orderly.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the Office of the Principal District & Sessions Judge, Darbhanga on or before 5 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. Who can apply for these Evening Court posts?
faq.answer: Only retired employees of the Civil Courts who retired within the last three years, as per the guidelines of the Hon'ble High Court, Patna, may apply, provided they have satisfactory service records and no major disciplinary punishment during service.

faq.question: Q4. What experience is needed for the Stenographer and Clerk posts?
faq.answer: The Stenographer must have the requisite experience and proficiency in shorthand and typing, and the Clerk must have adequate knowledge and experience of clerical and judicial office work.

faq.question: Q5. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Submit the application personally at the Office of the Principal District & Sessions Judge, Darbhanga, or send it by registered post so that it reaches the office by 5 December 2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for these posts?
faq.answer: The notice prints no amount; remuneration is governed by the applicable rules, guidelines and orders of the competent authority.

faq.question: Q7. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The engagement is purely contractual, can be terminated at any time as per the directions of the Hon'ble High Court, Patna, and gives no right to claim regular appointment or continuation in service.

faq.question: Q8. What are the working hours?
faq.answer: Selected candidates must perform their duties for a minimum of 05 hours on each working day.
